versions.changelog: v5: 支持9种元数据格式(PASCAL_VOC/KITTI/Classified_Tiles/RCNN_Masks/Labeled_Tiles/MultiLabeled_Tiles/Exported_Tiles/CycleGAN/Imagenet) + 4种图像格式(TIFF/MRF/JPG/PNG)，自动检测格式，无需手动指定

- Initial release of arcgis-training-data-fix.
- Automatically generates missing ArcGIS Pro deep learning training files: esri_model_definition.emd, esri_accumulated_stats.json, map.txt, and stats.txt, strictly following Pro standard formats.
- Detects annotation format (PASCAL VOC or KITTI) and calculates necessary statistics from images and labels.
- Cleans up incorrectly named (.emd/.json) files, ensuring only Pro-standard files remain.
- Designed for scenarios where Export Training Data gets stuck, or required files are missing or need manual completion.
